title: announce — defend

sentences.sentence: They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
sentences.translation: 他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。

sentences.sentence: At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
sentences.translation: 会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

phrases.translation: 奥委会；奥林匹克运动委员会
特别委员会，专门委员会
计划委员会；规划委员会
伦理委员会；道德委员会

sentences.sentence: a committee meeting
sentences.translation: 委员会会议

phrases.translation: 以优异成绩，以杰出的表现

sentences.sentence: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
sentences.translation: 这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。

phrases.translation: 现场应用；野外使用；预涂涂装

sentences.sentence: We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
sentences.translation: 我们每年收到数百封求职信。

sentences.sentence: I filled in the application form and sent it off.
sentences.translation: 我填完申请表后把它寄了出去。

sentences.sentence: You have to submit your application before the end of the month.
sentences.translation: 月底之前必须递交申请。

sentences.sentence: I’ve put in an application for a transfer.
sentences.translation: 我已递交了调动申请。

sentences.sentence: He received a letter saying that his application had been rejected .
sentences.translation: 他收到一封信，告知他的申请已被拒绝。

sentences.sentence: It can take a long time for your visa application to be processed .
sentences.translation: 办理签证申请可能需要很长时间。

sentences.sentence: The Council is currently reviewing the way it deals with planning applications .
sentences.translation: 市政会目前正在审查其处理规划申请的方式。

sentences.sentence: Thank you for your letter of application , which we received yesterday.
sentences.translation: 你的申请信昨天收悉，谢谢。

sentences.sentence: Do you fancy going to the pub?
sentences.translation: 你想去酒吧吗？

sentences.sentence: a pub lunch
sentences.translation: 酒吧午餐

sentences.sentence: the pub landlord
sentences.translation: 酒吧老板

sentences.sentence: Her screams of delighted laughter filled the air.
sentences.translation: 她喜悦的尖叫声在空中荡漾。

sentences.sentence: The first edition was published in 1765.
sentences.translation: 第一版于1765年出版。

sentences.sentence: They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
sentences.translation: 那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

phrases.translation: 入射光；入射波束，入射电子束

sentences.sentence: Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
sentences.translation: 我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？

sentences.sentence: Roads were sealed off because of a major incident.
sentences.translation: 因为发生重大事故，道路被封锁了。

sentences.sentence: Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
sentences.translation: 默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

sentences.sentence: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
sentences.translation: 她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

sentences.sentence: The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
sentences.translation: 炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。

sentences.sentence: Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
sentences.translation: 苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

sentences.sentence: She still needs to analyse the data.
sentences.translation: 她仍需要分析这些数据。

sentences.sentence: You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
sentences.translation: 你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。

sentences.sentence: Joe had never tried to analyze their relationship.
sentences.translation: 乔从未试图去理清他们的关系。

sentences.sentence: A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
sentences.translation: 外交部出现了危机。

sentences.sentence: More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
sentences.translation: 核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

phrases.translation: 对…应负责任；应该为某事负责任

sentences.sentence: Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
sentences.translation: 别来怪我——又不是我的错。

sentences.sentence: I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
sentences.translation: 怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

phrases.translation: 心甘情愿努力干活的人

sentences.sentence: I soon had an army of willing helpers.
sentences.translation: 我很快就拥有了一批热心的帮手。

sentences.sentence: a child’s developing sense of self
sentences.translation: 儿童逐渐形成的自我意识

sentences.sentence: The factory employs over 2,000 people.
sentences.translation: 这家工厂雇用了2,000多名员工。

phrases.translation: 法律文件；法定单证（legal document的复数）

sentences.sentence: What the company has done is perfectly legal.
sentences.translation: 公司所做的这一切完全合法。

sentences.sentence: plans to make the carrying of identity cards a legal requirement
sentences.translation: 使携带身份证成为法定要求的计划

sentences.sentence: He had twice the legal limit of alcohol in his bloodstream.
sentences.translation: 他血液中的酒精含量是法定限度的两倍。

sentences.sentence: a pressure group that is campaigning to make cannabis legal
sentences.translation: 争取大麻合法化的压力团体

phrases.translation: 想做做不到的事；缘木求鱼

sentences.sentence: Weather conditions prevented them from attempting the jump.
sentences.translation: 天气状况使他们无法尝试跳伞。

sentences.sentence: a struggle to defend our homeland
sentences.translation: 保卫我们祖国的斗争

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 46 单元

announce
音标：英 /ə'naʊns/  美 /ə'naʊns/
vt. 宣布，宣告
例句：They announced their engagement in ‘The Times’.
他们在《泰晤士报》上宣布了订婚的消息。
例句：At the end of their meeting, it was announced that an agreement had been reached.
会议最后宣布已达成一项协议。

committee
音标：英 /kə'mɪtɪ/  美 /kə'mɪti/
n. 委员会
短语：party committee — 党委
短语：standing committee — 常务委员会
短语：central committee — 中央委员会
短语：organizing committee — 组织委员会
短语：olympic committee — 奥委会；奥林匹克运动委员会
短语：committee member — 委员
短语：management committee — 管理委员会
短语：executive committee — 执行委员会
短语：the international olympic committee — 国际奥林匹克委员会（IOC）
短语：national committee — 全国委员会
短语：advisory committee — 咨询委员会
短语：audit committee — 审计委员会
短语：technical committee — 技术委员会
短语：special committee — 特别委员会，专门委员会
短语：planning committee — 计划委员会；规划委员会
短语：steering committee — 指导委员会
短语：organization committee — 组委会；组织委员会
短语：arbitration committee — 仲裁委员会
短语：ethics committee — 伦理委员会；道德委员会
短语：education committee — 教育委员会
例句：a committee meeting
委员会会议

distinction
音标：英 /dɪ'stɪŋ(k)ʃ(ə)n/  美 /dɪ'stɪŋkʃən/
n. 殊荣；特质；区别
短语：without distinction — 无差别
短语：with distinction — 以优异成绩，以杰出的表现
短语：class distinction — 阶级界限
短语：to make a distinction — 区别
例句：There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas.
这两个酿酒区之间有明显的不同。

application
音标：英 /ˌæplɪ'keɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /ˌæpləˈkeʃən/
n. 申请（书）；应用
短语：practical application — 实际应用
短语：application for — 申请
短语：clinical application — 临床应用
短语：wide application — 应用广泛
短语：application form — 申请表，申请书
短语：application system — 应用系统
短语：application software — 应用软体
短语：on application — 函索，索取
短语：application development — [计]应用开发
短语：application range — 应用领域
短语：field application — 现场应用；野外使用；预涂涂装
短语：application technology — 应用技术
短语：application field — 应用区域，应用范围
短语：scope of application — 适用范围
短语：computer application — 计算机应用
短语：application process — 应用进程
短语：application research — 应用研究
短语：application program — [计]应用程序
短语：application method — 使用方法；敷帖法
短语：visa application — 签证申请
例句：We receive hundreds of job applications each year.
我们每年收到数百封求职信。
例句：I filled in the application form and sent it off.
我填完申请表后把它寄了出去。
例句：You have to submit your application before the end of the month.
月底之前必须递交申请。
例句：I’ve put in an application for a transfer.
我已递交了调动申请。
例句：He received a letter saying that his application had been rejected .
他收到一封信，告知他的申请已被拒绝。
例句：It can take a long time for your visa application to be processed .
办理签证申请可能需要很长时间。
例句：The Council is currently reviewing the way it deals with planning applications .
市政会目前正在审查其处理规划申请的方式。
例句：Thank you for your letter of application , which we received yesterday.
你的申请信昨天收悉，谢谢。

pub
音标：英 /pʌb/  美 /pʌb/
n. 小酒馆，酒吧
例句：Do you fancy going to the pub?
你想去酒吧吗？
例句：a pub lunch
酒吧午餐
例句：the pub landlord
酒吧老板

delighted
音标：英 /dɪ'laɪtɪd/  美 /dɪ'laɪtɪd/
adj. 高兴的，愉快的
短语：delighted with — 高兴；对…感到高兴
例句：Her screams of delighted laughter filled the air.
她喜悦的尖叫声在空中荡漾。

publish
音标：英 /'pʌblɪʃ/  美 /'pʌblɪʃ/
vt. 出版，发行
例句：The first edition was published in 1765.
第一版于1765年出版。
例句：They are publishing the dictionary on CD-ROM.
那部词典他们将以光盘版的形式推出。

incident
音标：英 /'ɪnsɪd(ə)nt/  美 /'ɪnsɪdənt/
n. 事件，事情
短语：incident angle — 入射角
短语：incident light — [化]入射光
短语：incident wave — 入射波
短语：incident beam — 入射光；入射波束，入射电子束
短语：incident ray — 入射线
短语：critical incident — 危机事故
短语：incident energy — 入射能
短语：incident rate — 事件率，呼唤率
短语：incident radiation — 入射辐射
短语：incident power — 入射功率
例句：Am I at risk because of some incident in my sexual past?
我过去性生活中的某件事会使我处于危险境地吗？
例句：Roads were sealed off because of a major incident.
因为发生重大事故，道路被封锁了。

evidence
音标：英 /'evɪd(ə)ns/  美 /'ɛvɪdəns/
n. 证明，证据
短语：in evidence — 明显的；[法]作为证据
短语：give evidence — 作证
短语：empirical evidence — 实验性证据
短语：strong evidence — 有力证据；真凭实据
短语：substantial evidence — 确实证据
短语：on evidence — adv. 有证据
短语：conclusive evidence — 决定性证据
短语：material evidence — 物证；主要证据
短语：clear evidence — 明显证据
短语：direct evidence — 直接证据
短语：ample evidence — 充分证据
短语：objective evidence — 客观证据
短语：documentary evidence — 证明文件；书面证明
短语：concrete evidence — 证据确凿；具体的证据
短语：convincing evidence — 令人信服的证据
短语：physical evidence — 物证
短语：clinical evidence — 临床证据；临床迹象
短语：anecdotal evidence — 轶事证据
短语：circumstantial evidence — 间接证据；旁证
短语：audit evidence — 审计证据；查帐证据
例句：Murrow’s evidence was enough to convict Hayes of murder.
默罗的证词足以证明海斯犯了谋杀罪。

explanation
音标：英 /eksplə'neɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɛksplə'neʃən/
n. 解释，说明
短语：in explanation of — 解释
短语：special explanation — 特别说明
例句：She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday.
她告诉法庭她将在星期一就控方的决定做出详尽的解释。

explode
音标：英 /ɪk'spləʊd; ek-/  美 /ɪk'splod/
vi&vt. 爆炸
短语：explode into — 爆发出…
例句：The device was thrown at an army patrol but failed to explode.
炸弹投向了陆军巡逻队，但没有爆炸。
例句：Far sooner than anyone thought possible, the Russians exploded an atomic bomb.
苏联引爆了一颗原子弹，大大早于任何人的预期。

analyse
音标：英 /'æn(ə)laɪz/  美 /'æn(ə)laɪz/
vt. 分析
例句：She still needs to analyse the data.
她仍需要分析这些数据。
例句：You need to sit down and analyse why you feel so upset.
你得坐下来想一想自己为什么会那么生气。
例句：Joe had never tried to analyze their relationship.
乔从未试图去理清他们的关系。

arise
音标：英 /ə'raɪz/  美 /ə'raɪz/
vi. 发生，出现
短语：arise from — 由…引起，起因于
短语：arise out of — 起于……
例句：A crisis has arisen in the Foreign Office.
外交部出现了危机。
例句：More problems like those at the nuclear power plant are certain to arise.
核电厂肯定还会出现那样的问题。

blame
音标：英 /bleɪm/  美 /blem/
vt. 责怪，归咎于
短语：blame for — 责备；因……责备
短语：take the blame — 承担过错
短语：put the blame on — 归咎于…
短语：be to blame for — 对…应负责任；应该为某事负责任
短语：bear the blame — 承担责任
例句：Don’t blame me – it’s not my fault.
别来怪我——又不是我的错。
例句：I blame his mother. She does everything for him.
怪他母亲不好，她什么事都要为他做。

willing
音标：英 /'wɪlɪŋ/  美 /'wɪlɪŋ/
adj. 愿意的，乐意的
短语：be willing to do — 乐意做某事，愿意做
短语：god willing — 如果情况允许的话
短语：a willing horse — 心甘情愿努力干活的人
短语：show willing — [口语]愿意做，同意
例句：I soon had an army of willing helpers.
我很快就拥有了一批热心的帮手。

self
音标：英 /self/  美 /sɛlf/
n. 自我，自身
短语：by one's self — 独自，单独
短语：true self — 真我；真实自我
短语：self esteem — 自尊
短语：self control — 自我控制；自制
短语：self learning — 自学习
短语：real self — 真实自我
短语：self study — 自学
短语：second self — 知己；心腹；左右手
短语：self similarity — 自相似
短语：self weight — 自重
短语：self consciousness — 自我意识；自觉意识
短语：self improvement — 自我完善；自我改进
短语：self first — 先顾自己
短语：self locking — 自销；自同步；自锁式
短语：self cleaning — 自净，自动清洗
短语：self reliance — 自力更生；依靠自已
短语：self image — 自身形象
短语：self regulation — 自动调整；自律
短语：self excited — 自激的；自励
短语：self test — 自检测试
例句：a child’s developing sense of self
儿童逐渐形成的自我意识

employ
音标：英 /ɪm'plɒɪ; em-/  美 /ɪm'plɔɪ/
vt. 雇用；花时间做
短语：employ in — 被…雇佣；受聘于
短语：in the employ of — adv. 受雇于
例句：The factory employs over 2,000 people.
这家工厂雇用了2,000多名员工。

legal
音标：英 /'liːg(ə)l/  美 /'ligl/
adj. 合法的，与法律有关的
短语：legal system — 法律制度
短语：legal status — 法律地位
短语：legal protection — 法律保护；合法保护
短语：legal services — 法律服务
短语：legal responsibility — 法律责任
短语：legal aid — 法律援助
短语：legal liability — 法律责任
短语：legal action — 法律诉讼
短语：legal right — 合法权利，法定权利
短语：legal entity — 法人实体
短语：legal effect — 法律效力
短语：legal representative — n. 法定代理人
短语：legal documents — 法律文件；法定单证（legal document的复数）
短语：legal advice — 法律意见；[法]法律谘询
短语：legal education — 法制教育
短语：legal framework — 法律体制
短语：legal practice — 法律实践
短语：legal profession — 法律界；法律专业
短语：legal counsel — 法律顾问；法律指导
短语：legal regulation — 法律条例
例句：What the company has done is perfectly legal.
公司所做的这一切完全合法。
例句：plans to make the carrying of identity cards a legal requirement
使携带身份证成为法定要求的计划
例句：He had twice the legal limit of alcohol in his bloodstream.
他血液中的酒精含量是法定限度的两倍。
例句：a pressure group that is campaigning to make cannabis legal
争取大麻合法化的压力团体

attempt
音标：英 /ə'tem(p)t/  美 /ə'tɛmpt/
vt&n. 尝试，试图
短语：attempt at — 企图，努力；尝试
短语：attempt to do something — 努力...；试图...
短语：attempt to do — 尝试去做
短语：attempt the impossible — 想做做不到的事；缘木求鱼
短语：make an attempt — 试图
例句：Weather conditions prevented them from attempting the jump.
天气状况使他们无法尝试跳伞。

defend
音标：英 /dɪ'fend/  美 /dɪ'fɛnd/
vt. 为⋯⋯辩解；保卫
短语：defend oneself — 自卫；申辩；自行辩护
短语：defend against — 防卫，保卫；抵抗
短语：defend with — 用…防卫
例句：a struggle to defend our homeland
保卫我们祖国的斗争
